dataset.name: Evidence Inference 2.0 official test split, excluding previously inspected EV2 subset
dataset.scope: article-disjoint out-of-domain confirmation after development-split analysis
dataset.exclusion: exclude every source article in data/evidence_inference/ev2_test_article_ids.txt because prior Evidence Watchdog experiments inspected that EV2-only subset; use all remaining official test-split articles that join to prompts

question: Does the frozen sentence-preserving subdivision improve annotator-rationale visibility at a fixed displayed-text budget on official test articles not previously examined in this project?

cohort.include: remaining test-split prompts with at least one Valid Label=true and Valid Reasoning=true annotation with valid in-bounds source offsets
cohort.annotation_handling: group spans by PromptID and UserID; union spans only within annotator; average annotators within prompt; average prompts
cohort.overlap_checks: require zero overlap with train, validation, and previously inspected EV2 test article IDs
cohort.selection: source-ID exclusion only; no annotation or model outcome used for article inclusion

method: Use the exact candidate construction, BGE/BM25 scoring, token-cost definition, ranking, whole-unit packing, budgets, endpoints, and paired article-cluster bootstrap frozen in evidence_inference_official_dev_chunk_confirmation.json. No tuning or protocol changes.
primary_endpoint: BGE chunk-minus-paragraph source-character recall at 240 BGE-token budget
secondary_endpoints: token utilization, segmentation exceptions, offset exclusions, and pair truncation
interpretation_boundary: evidence-text visibility only; does not establish evidence sufficiency, answer correctness, reader benefit, or clinical decision impact
